issues.issue: Mixed line. The rules say a mixed line takes its dominant category plus review, not 'other'. Most of it is the undescribed Bridge Fund Local 1,518,973, so the dominant part is unknown. The report does show some pieces: Statement of Activities p2/p3 has charges for services 284,067 + general 'Local fees...' 1,574,422 = 1,858,489, and the Inheritance Tax Fund column (p4) puts 133,406 of inheritance tax in this line (detail[64] categorizes that as inheritance tax). Left as is, about 33% of governmental receipts are in 'other'.
Principal and interest are combined. The page doesn't split them; the whole amount went to principal (review flag already set).
Combined principal and interest assigned entirely to principal (review flag already set).

The category rules list noxious weed control under natural resources/conservation. The schedule prints it under Public Works, so streets/highways is defensible. Applies to detail[48]-detail[51]; no review flag was set.
